thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the cloud marketplace joint announce with CloudScale + SI partners. are we still aiming for May 12? need press embargo, blog, landing page, and demo readiness :calendar:

sam: yes May 12 is the target from product. can marketing hit that? what's the blocker? :eyes:

jordan: build side: marketplace listing draft is ready, but we need final assets and the partner logo bundle. also need manifest + pricing SKU from CloudScale.

akshay: SI integrations team — we need a list of quickstart steps for partners to onboard and a prebuilt terraform module. ETA for that is end of next week unless we push.

elaine: marketing here. main blockers: (1) embargo timing confirmation, (2) legal sign-off on co-branded copy, (3) localized microcopy for EN/FR/DE. can do copy + blog draft by Tue if embargo confirmed.

nikhil: sales/partner ops — CloudScale asked to keep embargo until launch window. they prefer Apr 30 embargo lift for press outreach. can we meet in middle?

maria: decision: we need formal embargo date by EOD tomorrow. if CloudScale insists on Apr 30 we'll move announcement to May 6 to allow two full business days of outreach. any objections?

sam: fine with May 6 if CloudScale locks Apr 30 embargo. product to freeze feature list by Thu.

partner-bot: CloudScale PM @anna confirmed via DM: "we can do Apr 30 embargo if Redwood finalizes landing + assets by Apr 25."

jordan: that gives eng 5 business days to finalize the listing integration and QA for marketplace flow — doable but tight. need final partner logo bundle + SKU and a test tenant.

akshay: for SI demos: recommend we prepare 2 demo scripts — "out of box" and "custom workflow". I'll own the scripts and the demo VM prep. will post links in #devex when ready.

elaine: draft timeline proposal:
```
- Apr 18: final creative brief to partners
- Apr 20: legal and brand sign-off deadline
- Apr 22: blog + press draft ready for internal review
- Apr 25: assets + landing final cutoff (CloudScale INBOUND)
- Apr 30: embargo lift (partner outreach window opens)
- May 6: public announcement + blog + landing + demo sessions
```

maria: pls add rollout roles in that timeline (who does PR outreach, who monitors channels, who runs demo hours).

elaine: assigning roles: PR outreach -> elaine (+ agency), demo hours -> akshay + jordan, launch ops -> sam, partner comms -> nikhil, legal escalation -> legal. I'll add to the calendar invite.

legal: quick note: we need partner-approved trademark usage and a short MD/PR checklist signed. legal can review within 48 hrs once we get partner copy. tag us early to avoid last-minute delays.

nikhil: can partner legal sign the co-marketing MSA before Apr 22? CloudScale legal said they'd prioritize. I'll escalate with them today.

maria: outstanding tech checklist from eng side (jordan/akshay): please confirm by EOD Mon:
- marketplace SKU + pricing stub present
- test tenant provisioned for CloudScale
- 1-click deploy sample (terraform module) in repo
- telemetry/UTM params wired for landing and blog
- demo VM image + sample data

jordan: confirm all except terraform module — that's in PR and should merge by Mon end. will ping when merged.

akshay: demo VM image and sample data ready. terraform PR small refactor left.

elaine: measurement: add UTM tags -> utm_source=marketplace, utm_medium=listing, utm_campaign=cloudscale-apr2026. marketing analytics will track landing -> signup funnel.

maria: runbook for launch day? short version pls — who monitors, slack channel, pager, incident owner for listing failures.

sam: ops runbook draft: monitor marketplace-telemetry, listing-job-alerts, and HTTP 5xx spikes. oncall shift: eng-sre + marketplace eng for first 4 hours post-launch. I'll post the explicit runbook doc.

partner-bot: calendar invite created: "Marketplace Launch Rehearsal" Apr 28 10:00-11:30 PT. attendees: maria, elaine, sam, jordan, akshay, nikhil, CloudScale PMs.

maria: rehearsal is crucial — agenda: announce script, demo dry run, press Q&A mock, rollback test. please RSVP.

elaine: will finalize press pitch and embargo email template by Apr 21 and share here.

nikhil: I'll get CloudScale to confirm SKU + test tenant by Apr 20. pinging them now.

jordan: one more: merchant agreements page — does marketing want link in landing or only in listing? affects legal copy.

elaine: include a small "partner terms" link on landing that points to a hosted merchant doc. legal to approve copy.

legal: noted. will prioritize the short merchant terms and return with revisions within 48 hrs after receipt.

maria: ok team — action items summarized: elaine: press + blog draft, build landing microcopy; nikhil: partner coordination + legal chase; jordan: finalize listing PR + test tenant; akshay: demo scripts + terraform PR; sam: launch ops runbook; legal: merchant terms + trademark signoff. deadline: Apr 25 for all final assets.

sam: +1. any blockers after Apr 25 we escalate to execs.

maria: thanks all. tagging @CloudScale PMs to confirm embargo/asset timeline. :rocket:
